esqlQuery.esql:
FROM serverless_billing_cost_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| INLINE STATS org_earliest_ts = MIN(@timestamp), org_latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp)
| WHERE deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != ""
| EVAL has_obs_ts = CASE(group_first_seen_at IS NOT NULL, 1, 0),
       is_bf = CASE(COALESCE(group_initial_backfill, false), 1, 0),
       eff_seen_ts = COALESCE(group_first_seen_at, @timestamp)
| STATS
    first_seen = MIN(eff_seen_ts),
    any_obs_ts = MAX(has_obs_ts),
    any_backfill = MAX(is_bf)
  BY deployment_group, org_earliest_ts, org_latest_ts
| WHERE any_backfill == 0
    AND CASE(
      any_obs_ts == 1,
      first_seen >= NOW() - 3 days,
      org_latest_ts > org_earliest_ts AND first_seen > org_earliest_ts AND first_seen >= org_latest_ts - 3 days
    )
| EVAL first_seen_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(first_seen), 10),
       result = CONCAT("New chargeback group `", deployment_group, "` first observed on ", first_seen_day, ".")
| SORT deployment_group ASC
| KEEP result, deployment_group, first_seen_day
